parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for the human sodium-dependent dopamine transporter (CHEMBL238). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Join docs via activities.doc_id to capture PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records via activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Return all requested columns including compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
